name: techdrawai
description: Photo or text to technical drawing, CAD-ready DXF and DWG, printable STL, 3D models and product renders.
long_description: TechDraw AI turns a photograph of a physical part, or a written description of one, into engineering documentation, directly from Claude. Draft a dimensioned, standards-compliant 2D technical drawing (ISO or ANSI, first or third angle, working, assembly, as-fitted or patent), trace it into real CAD contours as DXF or DWG at true size, extrude artwork into a printable STL, reconstruct a part as a textured 3D mesh from a photo or a drawing, or render it as a finished product shot. Tools: generate_technical_drawing, text_to_technical_drawing, image_to_dxf, image_to_stl, render_product, photo_to_3d, drawing_to_3d, identify_product and check_credits. Requires a TechDraw AI API key on the Studio plan; every generation is billed to your own account credits and refunded automatically on failure.

tools.name: generate_technical_drawing
tools.description: Turn a product photo into a dimensioned 2D technical drawing with orthographic views, dimension lines and the projection symbol (5 credits).

tools.name: text_to_technical_drawing
tools.description: Draw a part from a written description with its sizes, no photo. Stated numbers are drawn as given, anything left out is marked nominal (5 credits).

tools.name: image_to_dxf
tools.description: Trace any image into real CAD contours and write a DXF, optionally a DWG as well. Set width_mm for true size (free).

tools.name: image_to_stl
tools.description: Trace flat artwork such as a logo or stencil and extrude it into a watertight, printable STL (free).

tools.name: render_product
tools.description: Reconstruct the object described by a technical drawing and render it as a photorealistic product shot (5 credits).

tools.name: photo_to_3d
tools.description: Reconstruct a textured 3D mesh from a photo of a single object, downloaded as GLB (80 credits).

tools.name: drawing_to_3d
tools.description: Turn a technical drawing into a textured 3D mesh in one call, rendered then reconstructed (80 credits).

tools.name: identify_product
tools.description: Name the main object in a photo, to fill in the product name before drafting (free).

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Show the account's credit balance, plan and per-operation costs.

api_key.title: TechDraw AI API Key
api_key.description: Your tda_sk_ API key from techdrawai.com/app (Settings, API keys). Requires an active Studio plan.
